rv.q: It's a magical performance that the young and old will enjoy.
The soundtrack that sticks with you is a bonus worth the price of admission alone.
The band’s accompaniment is perfectly in synch and sets the mood for this spectacular production.

cn.t: Critics praise this high-energy musical about Rock and Roll Hall of Famer Lloyd Price for its upbeat performances and unforgettable songs, even if the subject may be unfamiliar to younger audiences.
